blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Six minus two times the absolute value of three minus eight.
Absolute value bars group like parentheses, so work inside first. Three minus eight is negative five.
Absolute value is the distance from zero, so the absolute value of negative five is five.
Multiplication next. Two times five is ten.
Then six minus ten is negative four.
So the answer is negative four.
Watch out for these traps. If you subtract six minus two first, you get twenty. If you ignore the absolute value bars, you get sixteen.
